How it works

A simple process. A big impact.

Four steps between a finished meal and a review that compounds — with the feedback you can actually act on captured along the way.

01

Scan

Customer scans the QR code on a table, menu, bill, packaging, counter or social media.

02

Rate & Feedback

They rate the specific product or service and give quick, structured feedback.

03

Review

Satisfied customers can continue to Google or another public review destination.

04

Grow

You receive reviews, feedback, analytics and actionable insights — per product and per outlet.

AI review writer

Customers rarely write reviews. They will approve one.

The hard part was never the rating — it is the blank text box. ReviewDot turns what a customer already told you into a review they can edit and post in one tap.

What the customer types

The draft they can edit

Run it to see the draft

The writer may only restate what the customer wrote. Prices, wait times, dishes and ratings they never mentioned are rejected before the draft is shown.
